name: Mummy Issues Femboy Futa Pharaohs
source: Awaken a forgotten court of femboys and futanari in this Egyptian mythology-inspired visual novel. Solve puzzles, build relationships, and face ancient secrets and modern chaos as you work to break a deadly curse.
translation: 在这部汲取古埃及神话灵感的视觉小说中，唤醒一座被世人遗忘的伪娘与扶她宫廷。解开重重谜题、建立亲密羁绊，在古老秘辛与现代乱局交织之中设法破除致命诅咒吧。
